nodes.name: P1 cases
nodes.notes: Seeded calls that must all be refused (wrong key, wrong method). Extend to the 50 cases in P1.

nodes.name: Chain call
nodes.notes: Calls lib chain-call, the only door to NEAR. Mock mode checks the mandate in the database; testnet mode signs with the right limited key.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO eval_results (run_id, pass_mark, case_id, expected, actual, passed, tx_hash, details)
VALUES ($1, 'P1', $2, 'rejected', $3, $4::boolean, $5, $6::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (run_id, pass_mark, case_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Save result
nodes.notes: One eval_results row per case: expected rejected, actual, passed.

nodes.name: Summary
nodes.notes: Prints passed / total against the target.
